name: Re:quiem [Spring is in the air.]
source:
The story of young people who are at the mercy of their "youth."

Ichihana Sayuri is a 17 year old student who attends Tsukigaoka Jogakuin.

One day her friend, Akaizawa Ayame, decided she wanted to find out if the rumor about a corpse resting underneath the cherry tree was true or not.

Throughout their invesitgation their other friend, Tsuzura Tomoe, is revealed to have a secret. Sayuri's relationship with her childhood friend, Sakura Yuu, will also change.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28594]Freem![/url]]
translation:
年轻人受“青春”支配的故事。

一花小百合是一名17岁的学生，就读于月丘女学院。

有一天，她的朋友赤泽绫女决定查明有关樱花树下躺着尸体的传言是否属实。

在他们的调查过程中，他们的另一个朋友津津拉友发现了一个秘密。小百合与儿时好友佐仓优的关系也将发生变化。
